name: METRONIDAZOLE / NYSTATIN 12 SUPPLY
description: The combination of metronidazole and nystatin suppositories, in a 7-unit formulation, is a gynecological medication used to treat vaginal infections with multiple causes, including bacterial, fungal, and protozoal infections. A 7-day course of treatment is a common dosage regimen. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
